summary: Firelookout.ca places this steel tower at Les Lacs-du-Témiscamingue, Quebec, though its region field says Ontario; the only dated record is a 1963 Lands and Forests map.

events.note: Listed on the Department of Lands and Forests Tower Detection System Map (1963), as Firelookout.ca cites it. No build date is given.

corrections.why: Firelookout.ca gives the address as Les Lacs-du-Témiscamingue, Quebec, and the coordinates fall inside Quebec's boundary. The same page's region field reads Ontario, so a human should confirm before changing.
Follows from the region correction above, if confirmed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.ca's address points to Quebec while its region field and our record say Ontario. The name appears in Head, Clara and Maria, a municipality on the Ottawa River, which may explain the label, but no source says so.

notes_for_editor: Record says Ontario, but Firelookout.ca's address is Les Lacs-du-Témiscamingue, Quebec, and the local Natural Earth province file puts the coordinates inside Quebec. Firelookout.ca's own region field still says Ontario, so decide whether this belongs in the Ontario list. Leads not cited because they could not be read as pages: a Facebook group snippet says the Head, Clara and Maria Public Library archives hold a photo of a tower built on the Quebec side of the Ottawa River for a better view; a 2027 Firelookout.ca listing gives 'Pembroke, Ontario' for the same coordinates. Only the 1963 map dates it. No build date, height, status, access, staffing or fire record was found, so the story is short.
